# Xila README header assets

Generated from [xila-project/brand](https://github.com/xila-project/brand/tree/bf983b6709a824af145a1c4c46b31ac9ead79389) at commit `bf983b6709a824af145a1c4c46b31ac9ead79389`, identity version `2.0.0`.

`header-light.svg` is black artwork for light themes; `header-dark.svg` is white artwork for dark themes. Both are transparent 1280 × 224 SVGs with outlined lettering and no installed-font or remote-resource dependency.

Edit `source/repository-headers.json` and the shared layout in brand, regenerate, and import both files together. These are deployment copies; consumer builds do not download or regenerate the artwork.

Lettering derives from Montserrat. The source font software retains its [SIL Open Font License](https://github.com/xila-project/brand/blob/bf983b6709a824af145a1c4c46b31ac9ead79389/fonts/OFL-Montserrat.txt). Repository software licenses are unchanged.
